actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is above 30% but below 45%, so baseline 80% contribution applies. Wallet allows 82.424 contribution. Broadcast norm as required every 5 rounds. Punishment is omitted due to single physical action limit.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round 5. Wallet is 103.03. Average contribution? Compute total contributed each round sum contributions: round1 total 150, round2 331, round3 151.6, round4 185.1. Average per round = (150+331+151.6+185.1)/4 = 817.7/4 = 204.425. Average contribution per agent per round = 204.425/6 ≈34.07 which is >30% of endowment (30). Percent of endowment 30% =30. So average >45%? 45% of 100=45. It's 34, so below 45 but above 30. Constitution: baseline 80% unless avg falls below 30% then increase extra 30%; when avg rises above 45% revert to baseline. Here avg 34% so baseline 80% applies. Also check punish: any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds? Resident1 contributed 0 both rounds1 and2? round1 0, round2 0 -> that's two consecutive rounds below 10. So punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet enough. Also Resident4 contributed 0 in rounds1,2,3,4 many zeros but not two consecutive? round1 60, round2 0, so not two consecutive low. Resident2 contributed 10 each round (10% exactly threshold? free rider threshold 10 units, so 10 is not less than 10). So punish Resident1.

We also need broadcast norm at round 5 (since first round broadcast, then every 5 rounds thereafter: round5). So broadcast message.

Contribution: 80% of wallet = 0.8*103.03 = 82.424. Contribute that amount.

Thus actions: contribute 82.424, punish Resident1 amount 10, broadcast message.

We can only one physical and one communication. Physical can be contribute; punish also physical, but only one physical allowed. Choose punish as physical? But need contribution also. Could we combine? limit at most one physical action. So must pick either contribute or punish. Constitution emphasizes contribute heavily. Punishment is optional. Might skip punish to meet limit. But we could choose punish as physical and skip contribution? That would violate contribution rule. Better contribute and skip punish. Could we do rest? No. So we contribute 82.424 and broadcast.

Explanation mention skipping punish due to limit.
